title: 歸去來辭圖（1982.152）
holder: 克利夫兰美术馆（藏品号 1982.152）
medium: Handscroll; ink and slight color on silk
one_line: 克利夫兰美术馆藏画作，馆方断代作「1300s」。**本条为著录级**：照录馆方记录，未作阐释。

rows: Handscroll; ink and slight color on silk

basics.text: **本条为著录级条目。**以上各项照录克利夫兰美术馆的藏品记录，字段名标明「馆方」者即其原文。本库尚未对其作独立核校，亦未就断代、归属、风格作任何判断——分期归入依据仅为：朝代名 → yuan；器类归入依据仅为：type=Painting。

items: Harrist, Robert E. "Watching Clouds Rise: A Tang Dynasty Couplet and Its Illustration in Song Painting." The Bulletin of the Cleveland Museum of Art 78, no. 7 (November 1991): 301–323.（Mentioned: p. 322, p. 311）

Wilson, J. Keith. "The Fine Art of Drinking: The Chinese Silversmith Zhu Bishan and His Sculptural Cups." The Bulletin of the Cleveland Museum of Art 81, no. 10 (December 1994): 380–401.（Reproduced: p. 395; Mentioned: p. 395, 401）

Tōyō kaiga no seika: tokubetsuten: Kurīvurando Bijutsukan no korekushon kara [東洋絵画の精華 : 特别展 : クリーヴラント美術館のコレクションから = Highlights of Asian painting from the Cleveland Museum of Art]. Nara, Japan: Nara National Museum, 1998.（Reproduced: p. 52, cat. no. 29）
Chou, Ju-hsi and Anita Chung. Silent poetry: Chinese paintings from the collection of the Cleveland Museum of Art. Cleveland, OH: Cleveland Museum of Art, 2015.（Reproduced: pp. 168–173）

dating.text: 馆方给出了年代，**但未在公开记录中说明这个年代依据什么**——是铭文、器形序列、共出器物还是风格比对，无从得知。本库的断代十档因此无法填写：**填任何一档都是替馆方作了它没作的声明。**

provenance.text: (Frank Caro [1904–1980], New York, NY, sold to the Cleveland Museum of Art)
The Cleveland Museum of Art, Cleveland, OH
